svg.title: MIMIC-IV RAAS portfolio: separate association and prediction-time workflows
svg.desc: The original association branch excludes ICU use over the entire admission and uses supplementary Firth odds ratios, separate unweighted L2 risk and marginal-effect estimates, and separate retrospective discrimination. The additional 04c prediction branch defines ward-confirmed eligibility at admission or 24 hours, retains later ICU transfers and evaluates subsequent in-hospital death. Prescription records do not confirm administration.
svg.text: MIMIC-IV RAAS portfolio: two distinct analysis branches
BigQuery SQL + Python | Admission-level analysis with patient-aware evaluation
Authorized MIMIC-IV v3.1 → adult base_admissions
Base: admissions + patients; branch-specific reads: icustays, prescriptions, transfers and POE
Adult hospital admissions include observation categories; patient-level inputs remain private
Original association analyses: 01–04b
Additional prediction-time evaluation: 04c
Original cohort: no ICU stay over the entire admission
ACEi/ARB prescription start: 0–<24h; crude rates in 04a
04b also applies the separate 24h landmark association rule
Supplementary Firth
Adjusted odds ratios
Original + landmark cohorts
Patient-cluster intervals
Separate unweighted L2
Risks, AME, age contrasts
Typical-profile age curves
Patient-cluster intervals
Separate retrospective discrimination (04b)
Class-balanced L2; patient-disjoint holdout
First 24h records and early deaths retained; no fixed prediction time
These AUCs do not describe admission-time or 24h prognosis
Unpenalized MLE: separated/nonconverged audit outputs only
At admission / +24h: alive, hospitalized, confirmed ward
No ICU entry up to that time; later ICU transfers retained
Uncertain location/timing excluded; no later-ward backfill
Time-specific predictors
Reconstructed age + recorded sex
24h companion: time-verified RAAS prescription record
Prescribed start 0–<24h AND linked POE order time ≤24h
Unweighted L2; training-only preprocessing
Patient-disjoint holdout; ROC/AP, Brier and calibration
Outcome: subsequent in-hospital death through discharge
Held-out-patient intervals conditional on trained models
Sparse admission holdout: bootstrap intervals withheld
Interpretation boundaries
Prescription records do not confirm administration. Associations do not establish treatment effects.
Different cohorts and estimands; internal retrospective evaluation does not establish prospective or external validity.
